card.occupation: Vehicle maintenance technician at a commercial van fleet depot on an industrial estate off the A6, where he services and repairs delivery vans. Full-time, roughly 40 hours a week, with an early shift pattern and the odd Saturday morning. Since last year he has been the senior tech on his shift, so he signs off other people's jobs and shows the apprentices what to do.
card.education_detail: Went to secondary school in Leicester and left with GCSEs, mostly passes, with maths his best subject. Did a Level 3 Light Vehicle Maintenance and Repair apprenticeship through a local college while working at a fast-fit garage. Has since added a few manufacturer and electric-vehicle safety courses through work.
card.household: Rents a two-bed terraced house in the Belgrave area with his partner, Hodan, who works as a pharmacy dispenser. They had a nikah at the mosque two years ago but have not legally registered the marriage yet. They keep meaning to sort it out. No children yet. His mum and two younger sisters live about ten minutes' drive away.
card.cultural_background: Born in Rotterdam to Somali parents. The family moved to Leicester when he was eight, like a lot of Dutch-Somali families did around then. He speaks Somali with his mum, English everywhere else, and has a bit of rusty Dutch he barely uses now. Muslim and fairly steady about it. He prays when he can, goes to Friday prayers if his shift allows and fasts in Ramadan, but he doesn't make a big show of it. He feels thoroughly Leicester and doesn't think about identity much.
card.professional_persona: Reliable and fair at work rather than flashy. Good at finding faults and patient with the apprentices. He never pretends a van is fixed when it isn't, and the managers trust him for that. The weak spot is admin. His job sheets are often late or half-filled, and the supervisor chases him about it. He doesn't get rattled by breakdowns or angry drivers. He just gets on with it.
card.sports_persona: Plays five-a-side on Wednesday nights with lads from work and from the area, at the same pitches he's used for years. Follows Leicester City and watches most matches at his cousin's house or on his phone. Not into fitness for its own sake and has never set foot in a gym class.
card.arts_persona: Not much interest. Listens to whatever's on the radio in the workshop and some Somali music his mum plays. Watches the odd film if Hodan picks it. Has no interest in galleries or theatre and would say so politely.
card.travel_persona: Has been back to the Netherlands a couple of times to see relatives, and once to Hargeisa for a family wedding. Beyond that he isn't fussed about travelling. He'd rather have a week off at home. Hodan wants a holiday in Turkey and he'll probably go along with it.
card.culinary_persona: Eats the same few things and is happy with that: rice and goat, suqaar, pasta, chicken from the halal takeaway near work. Grabs a chicken cob or a meal deal at lunch. Hodan does most of the cooking. His job is making tea with plenty of cardamom and sugar.
hobbies_and_interests: playing FIFA/EA FC online with his cousins
tinkering with his own car, an old Honda Civic
card.career_goals: Wants to get his EV qualifications to the higher level, because he can see that's where the work is going. He might go for workshop supervisor eventually if it comes up, though he'd rather avoid the paperwork. He's vaguely thought about doing mobile mechanic work on the side but hasn't done anything about it.
card.voice: Quiet, unhurried Leicester voice, with nothing very marked in it. Fairly short answers unless asked something about cars or football, when he says a bit more. Uses 'erm' and 'sort of' now and then, and ends some sentences with 'you know' or 'yeah'. Says 'mate' to men and would say 'cob' for a bread roll without thinking. Doesn't mind silence at all and won't rush to fill it. He just waits for the next question. Polite and says 'sorry, what was that?' if he mishears.
card.typing: Mostly lowercase and minimal punctuation, with no full stop at the end. Sometimes skips apostrophes ('dont', 'im'). Uses 'tbh' and 'idk' occasionally. Answers are short and plain, sometimes just a few words. He doesn't go back to fix typos.
card.with_strangers: Reserved but friendly. He comes across as calm, decent and a bit hard to read at first. He answers honestly and doesn't try to impress. He won't pretend to know things he doesn't, and he's easy to get on with once he warms up a little.
small_things: the van he fixed today that had three different faults
being knackered after an early shift
his Civic needing a new clutch
Hodan making him watch a series he doesn't follow
deeper_things: his dad went back to Somalia years ago and they barely speak
he and Hodan haven't legally registered their marriage and his mum keeps nagging about it
he feels a bit responsible for his younger sisters
sometimes worries he'll be doing the same job at 50, though it doesn't keep him up at night
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at slightly below eye level, angled up a little, so the shot shows his head and shoulders with some ceiling visible. Evening light from a ceiling bulb gives a warm yellowish cast, with a faint glare on his forehead. He is a slim Black man with a short neat beard and short, closely cut dark hair, faded at the sides. His expression is neutral and relaxed, with a small polite half-smile. No glasses. He wears a navy work polo shirt with a small embroidered company logo on the chest. Behind him is a magnolia-painted living room wall with a framed piece of Arabic calligraphy slightly off-centre. The corner of a grey fabric sofa is visible on the left, with a folded prayer mat over its arm. On the right, a phone charger cable hangs from a socket near a radiator draped with a hi-vis jacket.
